title: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data
description: Every residential property sale in England and Wales lodged with HM Land Registry: price, date, full address, property type, new build flag and tenure.
notes: Headerless CSV. district is the local authority in upper case, e.g. 'READING'. property_type: D detached, S semi-detached, T terraced, F flat/maisonette, O other. new_build: Y/N. tenure: F freehold, L leasehold. Filter to one district to keep it small.

title: UK House Price Index
description: Monthly mix-adjusted house price index and average prices by local authority, with breakdowns by property type and buyer type.
grain: one row per area per month

title: Energy Performance Certificates (domestic)
publisher: Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (address data has extra conditions)
description: Energy certificates for homes: floor area, number of habitable rooms, built form, age band and energy rating. Joins to sales by address to answer size or bedroom questions.
notes: Not downloaded yet; needs a free registration.

title: ONS Postcode Directory
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (with Royal Mail and OS conditions)
description: Every UK postcode with its coordinates and the areas it belongs to (local authority, ward, LSOA).

title: Price Index of Private Rents
description: Monthly private rent index and average rents by local authority and property size.
grain: one row per area per month
